typesList.title: Activity types
typesList.subtitle: Templates a facilitator can start in a chatroom. Each type defines the fields participants submit and how each submission is scored.
typesList.deleteFailed: Could not delete the activity type. Please try again.
typesList.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Any room currently running it will have the activity ended.
typesList.emptyText: Create an activity type so facilitators can run it in a room.

typesList.forbiddenText: Only a project owner can manage activity types.

typeForm.title: New activity type
typeForm.intro: Define a reusable activity: the fields participants submit, and how each submission is validated and scored.
typeForm.keyHelp: A stable identifier used by the API and code. Lowercase, no spaces; it cannot be changed after creation.
typeForm.name: Name
typeForm.nameHelp: The label facilitators see when they start this activity.
typeForm.retentionHelp: How long submissions are kept. Leave blank for no limit.
typeForm.payloadSchemaHelp: The fields a participant fills in and submits.
typeForm.schemaModeLockedHint: This schema was authored as raw JSON and can't be edited in the builder.
typeForm.schemaRawHint: Edit the JSON Schema directly. Nested objects, arrays, and enums are supported here.
typeForm.webhookHint: Each submission is sent (through the egress proxy) to your URL, which returns the score.
typeForm.mcpHint: Each submission is scored by an MCP tool running on one of this project's agents.
typeForm.inProcessHint: Each submission is scored instantly by a built-in validator that ships with the platform.
typeForm.inProcessValidatorHelp: The built-in scorer that runs against each submission.
typeForm.exactMatchFieldHelp: The submission field whose value is compared to the expected answer.
typeForm.exactMatchExpectedHelp: A submission is valid when this field equals this value.
typeForm.webhookUrlHelp: The endpoint that receives each submission and returns a JSON verdict.
typeForm.mcpAgentHelp: The agent whose MCP binding hosts the scoring tool.
typeForm.mcpBindingHelp: The MCP binding on the selected agent.
typeForm.mcpToolNameHelp: The name of the MCP tool that scores the submission.
typeForm.keyConflict: An activity type with this key already exists.
typeForm.configRejected: The validator configuration or schema was rejected. Please review it.
typeForm.activeConflict: This activity type is active in a room. End it before changing its fields or validator.
typeForm.createFailed: Could not create the activity type. Please try again.
typeForm.updateFailed: Could not update the activity type. Please try again.
